summary: Channels Production Fine Polish R1 after the continuous Source Library coarse pass. Improve toolbar and metadata readability, make row actions more discoverable, remove hover-time horizontal movement, tighten pagination/footnote rhythm, and keep focus/mobile behavior intact. Reconcile the legacy V2.47.125 structural contract so it no longer hard-codes the superseded action opacity value while retaining the no-two-column guard. Shared Shell, Navigation, data model, schema, migrations and updater mechanism remain unchanged. Production remains Owner manual.
